apps/web/app/api/admin/audit-coverage/ro.reason: Which event types the audit registry covers. No tenant row is read.

apps/web/app/api/admin/background-jobs/r.reason: A dead job carries the tenant's payload and the provider error, so both are held back unless a live grant covers that workspace.

apps/web/app/api/admin/content-reports/r.reason: A member filed the report and chose the excerpt it carries, which is the queue trust and safety works.

apps/web/app/api/admin/cost-operations/r.reason: What the platform paid providers. Aggregates, no tenant content.

apps/web/app/api/admin/economics/route.t.reason: Margin and spend aggregates across the platform.

apps/web/app/api/admin/feature-flags/[ke.reason: Flag overrides name a workspace or a person as a target and read nothing they own.
One flag definition and its kill switch.

apps/web/app/api/admin/model-rollout/rou.reason: Which models are at which rollout stage.

apps/web/app/api/admin/observability/exp.reason: Why one request routed as it did: providers, models, token counts and the refusal code, never the prompt.

apps/web/app/api/admin/privacy/erasures/.reason: The subject asked to be erased by email, and the request names only that email.

apps/web/app/api/admin/privacy/requests/.reason: The open data rights queue, each row raised by the subject it names.

apps/web/app/api/admin/product-metrics/r.reason: Counts of activity, no row a tenant owns.

apps/web/app/api/admin/routing-health/ro.reason: Provider fallback rates and the routing kill switches.

apps/web/app/api/admin/security/route.ts.reason: Security event counts, tenant lockdown and the workspace key posture. The key material itself resolves through the break-glass gate in organization-encryption-keys.

apps/web/app/api/admin/service-dashboard.reason: Links and health of the platform's own dashboards.

apps/web/app/api/admin/support-access/ro.reason: The grant register itself: requesting, approving, revoking and verifying the trail. It reads no workspace data.

apps/web/app/api/admin/takedown/route.ts.reason: A share or artifact its owner published to the open web, looked up by the public token anyone already holds.

apps/web/app/api/operator/route.ts.reason: Feedback and screenshots members sent to us through the feedback form, plus the platform's own sign-up and cost registers.

apps/web/app/api/plugins/[id]/lifecycle/.reason: The publication state of a directory plugin.

apps/web/app/api/support/handoff/agent/[.reason: A member asked for a human, and claiming the session is the answer to that request.
The transcript of the conversation a member opened with support, redacted of secrets before it is served.

apps/web/app/api/support/handoff/agent/q.reason: The queue of members waiting for a human, each entry raised by the member in it.

apps/web/app/api/support/tickets/[ticket.reason: A ticket the member opened, escalated to the next severity.
